ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity off-white/tan pixels to low-intensity black pixels, with the low-intensity pixels primarily localized along the peripheral trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region is a contiguous off-white/light-tan field. Heavy, irregular black banding (10-40 pixels deep) defines the entire trailing edge. Vertical black striations are mapped on the proximal left lobe. Punctate dark spots are scattered across the distal right lobe field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 92 degrees and a depth ratio of 0.15 relative to the total lobe wingspan.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Amplitude of peaks varies significantly, with the right lobe trailing edge exhibiting larger pixel-depth variations (jagged erosion) than the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to an upward convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, raised yellowish-white pixels (approx. 10-25 pixel diameter per unit) are visible at both the extreme left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, vertical linear marks (rake-like) are detected on the left lobe. Multiple thin, horizontal low-contrast grey scratches are visible in the central light field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular erosion and missing tissue segments along the trailing edge of the right lobe; heavy calcified clusters (barnacles) localized at the terminal points of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan pixel shift across the high-intensity areas, contrasting with brighter white pixel values localized near the median notch.
